deployments_detail.use: Smart-restaurant AI kitchen with robotic arms for dish portioning and automated pot-broth configuration; intelligent recipe/inventory systems

Automated cold-room with robotic arms that retrieve pre-packaged dishes from cold storage according to each diner's order and feed them into the automated serving system (part of the AI smart restaurant) [Panasonic (robotics partner)]

Self-developed automatic broth-mixing machine that produces individualized/personalized hot pot soup bases and stores each customer's preferred soup-base mix in the cloud for repeat visits [Haidilao (self-developed)]
Intelligent queuing, personalized recommendation, automated ordering, and intelligent feedback
50+ AI applications covering customer service, supply chain, and other operational aspects
"Little Fishing" (小捞捞) AI customer-service agent (Volcano Engine + Doubao) handling reservations, seating and bill queries via WeChat mini-program

Xiaolaolao AI voice assistant that handles table booking, confirms group size and arrival time, gives personalized dining recommendations (e.g. low-fat or children's options), and runs smart bill analysis to optimize coupon/membership usage
PUDU autonomous service/delivery robots used as food runners across multiple Haidilao locations to deliver dishes to tables and fetch used trays, using AI navigation/mapping [PUDU Robotics]

Intelligent queue-management and wait-time prediction system (WeChat/app-based) that predicts waiting times and gives smart seating recommendations based on customer preferences to improve wait experience

Intelligent Kitchen Management System (IKMS), a self-developed machine-learning/AI system that runs automated kitchen production management, monitors overall kitchen status, and coordinates the smart restaurant's automated food preparation [Haidilao (self-developed IKMS)]
Food delivery and welcome robots for task automation
AI vision systems for remote inspections
Intelligent Kitchen Management System (IKMS) powered by machine learning and AI for kitchen standardization
AI-driven autonomous robotic system for food preparation in kitchen
Humanoid robots for food delivery and task support
AI consultation system offering personalized on-menu dish suggestions to diners, being trialed at US (Cupertino/Bay Area, California) locations alongside entertainment/service robots

AI-based food-safety system in the smart restaurant that identifies food items approaching their expiry date and automatically disposes of them before processing new orders, with real-time tracking of expiration dates
